correctness.rationale: Explicit projective-line/normalized-functional bijection proves factor count and product decomposition. Nonzeroness has constant conditional retention a; the cyclic-line matrix has eigenvalues q^(n-1),q^-1; character orthogonality proves all trace masses. Conjugation orbit sizes prove pointwise masses and trace-one excess gives exact total variation. Boundary cases q=2,k=1,n=2 checked symbolically, prime-power q=4 verified independently. Two exact checkers enumerate every output matrix; finite verification is corroboration only.

value.rationale: Primitive idempotents form a natural conjugacy class and minimal nonzero projection stratum. The exact distribution for every matrix, finite field, dimension, and ordered word length completely answers a motivated probability problem. A persistent exact trace-one bias and sharp TV convergence after conditioning reveal previously hidden semigroup mixing structure, beyond an arbitrary finite slice or merely a code result.
